summary:
Assign a name to an unnamed socket. A socket created by socket_create() exists in the namespace but has no assigned name. The original translator describes this as having an IP address but no port. socket_bind() requests that port `port` be assigned to socket `s`.

The optional string argument specifies the IP address to bind. If a specific IP is supplied, bind only to that address; otherwise, bind to all available network interfaces (0.0.0.0).
details:
Return semantics:
Return EESUCCESS on success, or a negative value with one of these meanings on failure:

Errors

EEFDRANGE      Descriptor out of range
   EEBADF         Invalid descriptor
   EESECURITY     Security violation attempted
   EEISBOUND      Socket is already bound (named)
   EEADDRINUSE    Address already in use
   EEBIND         Problem binding (naming)
   EEGETSOCKNAME  Problem obtaining the socket name (getsockname)

All error names are defined in the driver source header `socket_err.h`.
